featureRoadmap.title: Editable PCB typography
featureRoadmap.value: Create labels, pin legends and branded board typography without an external SVG editor.
acceptance: Text stays editable after save/reopen and undo/redo.
Support font selection, size, alignment, spacing and multiline labels.
Use the merged Google Fonts catalogue with pinned font identities and portable frozen outlines, including mirrored rear artwork.
Show geometry-based print warnings using a named manufacturer profile.
featureRoadmap.regressionGate: Compare preview and exported geometry, round-trip text and fonts, both sides and undo.
implemented: Merged Google Fonts search, previews, styles and pinned font provenance preserved
Saved outlines display and export without font downloads
Geometry-based text and thin-ink print review

featureRoadmap.title: Drawing and shape editing
featureRoadmap.value: Create board artwork directly in Overprint.
acceptance: Rectangle, ellipse, line and pen tools with editable fill/stroke.
Select and edit nodes, combine/subtract/intersect shapes.
Snap to grid and board edges, with keyboard constraints.
Preserve editable geometry and undo grouping across project download/reopen.
featureRoadmap.regressionGate: Synthetic geometry, pointer/keyboard drawing, Boolean holes, rear transforms and exported silhouettes.
implemented: Editable rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses and lines
Pen paths, canvas node dragging and numeric node editing
Union, subtract and intersect filled paths with holes
Board/grid snapping and one-step undo

featureRoadmap.title: Reusable artwork library and board templates

acceptance: Review PR #39 and its existing library integration first.
Save a selection or a two-sided composition with a thumbnail.
Instances record their source revision and offer a preview before applying an update.
Detach instances and export/import the complete library without an account.
Never silently change existing board artwork.
featureRoadmap.regressionGate: Source revision update/detach, two-side placement, portable backup, storage failure recovery.
implemented: Existing local project gallery and revision-pinned library reconciled from main
Selection and two-sided composition snapshots, thumbnails and explicit update previews
Detach instances and portable project/library backups

featureRoadmap.title: Print preflight with clickable problem overlays
featureRoadmap.value: Help users find artwork that may not print as intended before ordering.
acceptance: Show thin strokes, small text, pad overlap and edge proximity on the actual board.
Click a finding to select and zoom to the geometry.
Separate unsupported export cases from advisory profile warnings.
Include a review report with manufacturing exports without claiming physical print qualification.

implemented: Advisory manufacturer legend profile with measured ink and gap checks
Clickable board overlays select and focus artwork
Fresh sourced JSON report included in manufacturing ZIP

featureRoadmap.title: Smart placement and board-aware guides
featureRoadmap.value: Lay out pin labels, repeated marks and artwork accurately with less manual work.
acceptance: Snap to pads, footprint anchors, board center and edges.
Repeat a selection along a line or around a circle with numeric spacing.
Show actual millimeter distances and respect mirrored back coordinates.
Preview the change before committing one undo step.
featureRoadmap.regressionGate: Numeric placement at nonzero board origins, rotated items, rear coordinates and single-step undo.
implemented: Pad and footprint anchors, center, board edges and origin-relative grid
Numeric line/circle repeat with cancelable ghost preview
Rear coordinate handling and one-step apply/undo

featureRoadmap.title: Palette and finish design workflow
featureRoadmap.value: Develop consistent visual styles that can be reused on multiple boards.
acceptance: Named project palettes with global color replacement and undo.
Consistent gradient/pattern previews and export rendering.
Explicitly distinguish decorative previews from supported manufacturing outputs.
Keep physical color matching dependent on printed samples.

Editable gradients, stripe and dot fills with frozen SVG output
Undo, persistence and explicit conversion before Live Paint

Apply/cancel validation and automatic recoverable local project revision
